source_text:
for any $q\in\Bbb Q$, $\lambda^*\{x:f(x)\le q\}$ is either $0$ or
$1$.
target_text:
untuk sembarang $q\in\Bbb Q$, $\lambda^*\{x:f(x)\le q\}$ bernilai $0$ atau
$1$.

source_text:
show that $g_n:[0,1]\to[0,1]^{n+1}$ is \imp\ for every
$n\ge 1$, where
$g_n(t)=(f_1(t),f_1f_2(t),\ldots,\penalty-100f_1f_2^{n-1}(t),f_2^n(t))$
for $t\in[0,1]$.
target_text:
tunjukkan bahwa $g_n:[0,1]\to[0,1]^{n+1}$ bersifat \imp\ untuk setiap
$n\ge 1$, dengan
$g_n(t)=(f_1(t),f_1f_2(t),\ldots,\penalty-100f_1f_2^{n-1}(t),f_2^n(t))$
untuk $t\in[0,1]$.
